title: AIDA Voice Banking Agent Tools
description: JSON Schema function declarations for Enterprise Bot AIDA tool calling integration (SessionToken secured)

function.name: authenticate_customer
function.description: Authenticates a customer using their bank Account Number and 4-digit PIN. Returns a short-lived sessionToken. MUST be invoked before accessing customer account details or performing banking operations.

function.name: get_account_balance
function.description: Fetches the current account balance and currency for the authenticated customer using their sessionToken.

sessionToken.description: The active session token obtained from authenticate_customer.

function.name: block_customer_card
function.description: Blocks a lost or stolen credit/debit card belonging to the authenticated customer using an atomic transaction and generates a reference ticket.

sessionToken.description: The active session token obtained from authenticate_customer.

cardLast4.description: The last 4 digits of the card to be blocked (e.g., '4821').

reason.description: The reason for blocking the card (e.g., 'stolen', 'lost', 'suspicious activity').

function.name: update_user_action_data
function.description: Updates non-sensitive customer metadata such as lastAction, lastTicketNumber, or phone number.

sessionToken.description: The active session token obtained from authenticate_customer.

lastAction.description: The last action taken by the customer (e.g., 'CARD_BLOCK').

lastTicketNumber.description: The reference ticket number associated with the action.

function.name: send_card_block_confirmation_email
function.description: Dispatches an email confirmation via Resend to the authenticated customer with their card block reference ticket.

sessionToken.description: The active session token obtained from authenticate_customer.

ticketNumber.description: The reference ticket number generated from the block_customer_card operation.
